title: SnackCraft
description: This mod adds many delicious snacks to Minecraft, collect materials to unlock recipes to make snacks, and you can get a variety of effects after eating snacks.
body:
![1.2.0](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e981ee899baf08eb076f4bd632c1ab34c7e2e2a5.png)
This mod is made using MCreator software, supports 1.21.4neoforge, and adds many delicious snacks to the game. When you gather some materials in survival, you will unlock some snack recipes at the workbench. You can gain various effects after consuming snacks, and you can also integrate other mods to view the snack recipes.

_If you have any comments or suggestions, or if you find a bug and would like feedback, please email snackcraftmodfeedback@hotmail.com****_

_**Everyone is welcome to come up with the snack ideas they want!**_

**Interlocution**

Q: Will the mod support lower versions?

A: At present, MCreator software is most suitable for 1.21.4neoforge, and the mod will be updated to a higher version in the future, so it will not be adapted for lower versions (if you wish to create a lower version of this mod, please indicate the original author).

Q: Can I add this mod to an modpack?

A: You can add this mod to your own modpack, but remember to credit the original author, and do not claim this mod as your own work.
